digest.component_or_area: reconciler .bridge_state committed cache and tickets-store history
propositions: The tickets branch is ~1.04 GiB with ~92% consumed by the reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache rather than ticket event data.
Per-pass scattered writes of baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass into the sort-ordered bindings.json defeat git delta compression and inflate marginal per-version pack cost.
baseline_advanced_at is written but read nowhere in src/, so removing it and guarding set_baseline to write only on change reduces churn.
Moving last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping to .bridge_state/get_rotation.json (dual-write, read max of new and legacy) halves version count under an expand-contract migration.
A one-time git fast-export/fast-import history strip reclaims ~91% of size while preserving all commits and merges and keeping the rewritten HEAD tree byte-identical via dynamic re-add.
A fail-closed store-epoch guard at sync._union_merge and push.py must abort stale-epoch clones without merging, gated by 24h descendant-workflow rollout evidence.
